acceptanceCriteria: Define and document one supported finish/check/seal order with exact source and terminal artifact bindings.
If sealed terminal-head satisfaction is supported, verify an immutable R100 map move and preserve final check/report identity rules; no unconditional stale-check reuse.
Retain a regression for the observed sequence and for source, map-byte or lineage changes that must invalidate evidence.
body:
Observed during CI speed work on installed official Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163 (2026-10-01). A frozen keyed dogfood plan with allowCemSidecarOnlyReuse=false passed selected checks and finish at commit44dbfa5ca01000931bcfa719a04cee0f30f9980b. The required make dogfood-check and make dogfood-seal passed; seal d305dca9 moves the CEM R100 to .corvint/changes/44dbfa5ca01000931bcfa719a04cee0f30f9980b.cem.json. Subsequent dogfood status has lifecycle=satisfied but satisfied=false, all selected checks unverified, report-set-stale and final-check-required. This is safe exact-head invalidation, not evidence that tests failed. The observed compatibility question is how the documented final source+CEM keyed finish and required sealed terminal artifact should compose without a repeat/bind/seal loop or a misleading current-head satisfaction claim. Source inspection: internal/localcompletion/finish.go prepareBindings/reports use the shared .corvint/change.cem.json path. PR425 retains truthful passed binding evidence and final seal proof, with the stale current-head limitation explicit. Reproduction evidence: /private/tmp/corvint-ci-finish-satisfied.json, corvint-ci-policy-sealed.json, corvint-ci-dogfood-check.log, corvint-ci-dogfood-seal.log. Dedup searches sealed and dogfood finish found no matching open item. Scope is clarification/compatibility; no gate weakening or runtime fix is inferred.

Read-only status then returns satisfied=false, selected-check-unverified for focused-tasks/vet-tasks/linux-parity, report-set-stale, final-check-required. This is an observed composition limit even with the admitted sidecar-only exception, not a test failure or safety-bug claim. No frozen-plan/private-state edits, cancellation, HEAD switch, sidecar recreation or Core implementation change were used to mask it. CEM1 reservation V1-0632 remains untouched. Original and sealed status, final finish JSON, check/seal logs, selected observations and plan are under /private/tmp/codex-ci-affected-0649/.git/corvint/ci-0649/. Source PR474 truthfully distinguishes checked727aade3 from sealeda4f0f0ea.
